items.q: So now you got Ray Charles.

ctx.x: So now you got Ray Charles.

Right, but even in this era with Ray Charles, Roland Kirk had a lot of problems because he was blind, and, you know, he told stories about they hired him for a TV show, and they said they couldn't insure him because he might trip over something and whatever, and so he lost the job, you know, things like that.
